2609.18134.title: Rethinking How We Evaluate Methodological Progress in Health AI
2609.18134.paper_summary: Methodological progress in artificial intelligence (AI) for electronic health records (EHRs) depends on our ability to determine which algorithms work better, and under which conditions. However, such progress is thought to be hindered by difficulties in reproducibility and in defining clinically meaningful evaluation tasks. We empirically study these barriers by re-implementing 12 historical and recent algorithms within a shared evaluation framework and evaluating them on two clinical datasets, MIMIC-IV and NWICU. We compare two complementary task families: expert-authored clinically meaningful tasks and generated tasks defined from randomly sampled event codes and prediction horizons. We ask whether relative algorithms comparisons transfer across task families and datasets, whether residual task heterogeneity contains useful methodological structure, and what a controlled comparison reveals about progress over the last decade. We find that aggregate pairwise comparisons transfer strongly across evaluation settings, including from randomly generated tasks to clinically meaningful tasks and across datasets. At the same time, clinically meaningful tasks exhibit greater task-method interaction, providing preliminary evidence that task properties can help explain when particular modeling choices are advantageous. Finally, newer algorithms do not consistently outperform earlier approaches: gradient-boosted trees remain highly competitive when paired with a modern, wide and sparse representation of the EHR. Together, these results suggest that useful methodological knowledge may require less task engineering than commonly assumed, while highlighting the importance of understanding the structured heterogeneity that remains across tasks and methods.
2609.18134.paper_summary_zh: 方法論在人工智慧 (AI) 於電子健康紀錄 (EHRs) 的進展取決於我們確定哪些演算法表現更好，以及在什麼條件下。然而，這樣的進展被認為受到可重複性和定義臨床上有意義的評估任務的困難所阻礙。我們通過在共享評估框架內重新實現 12 種歷史和最近的演算法，並在兩個臨床數據集 MIMIC-IV 和 NWICU 上進行評估，實證研究這些障礙。我們比較兩個互補的任務家族：專家撰寫的臨床上有意義的任務和從隨機抽樣事件代碼和預測範圍定義的生成任務。我們詢問相對演算法比較是否能在任務家族和數據集之間轉移，殘餘任務異質性是否包含有用的方法論結構，以及受控比較對於過去十年的進展揭示了什麼。我們發現，聚合的成對比較在評估設置之間強烈轉移，包括從隨機生成的任務到臨床上有意義的任務以及跨數據集。同時，臨床上有意義的任務顯示出更大的任務-方法互動，提供初步證據表明任務屬性可以幫助解釋何時特定的建模選擇是有利的。最後，較新的演算法並不總是優於早期的方法：梯度提升樹在與現代、寬且稀疏的 EHR 表示配對時仍然具有高度競爭力。綜合這些結果表明，有用的方法論知識可能需要的任務工程少於普遍假設的，同時強調理解在任務和方法之間仍然存在的結構化異質性的重要性。
